speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng
text: asked the Prime Minister (a) what is the outcome of investigations into the interruptions and service degradations in Singpass and Corppass services on 8 and 9 February 2018; (b) what redundancy mechanisms and systems are in place to maintain uninterrupted Singpass and Corppass service provision; and (c) what lessons have been learned from the recent interruptions.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
text: The services were intermittently slow or not responsive during these periods.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
text: This software bug was previously undetected and had only manifested after an enhancement to the Singpass and Corppass system in January 2018.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
text: Gemalto has acknowledged the software bug in their product and has been helpful and cooperative in the recovery process.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
text: We drew two key lessons from this experience.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
text: Our early detection and warning capabilities can be improved and will be improved.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
text: We intend to do so by enhancing the software checks and diagnostics so that, in such cases, the engineers can act before the system condition worsens to a state that would affect users.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
text: As a broader point, this episode shows that for our critical systems that rely on products from commercial providers, there is a need to work more closely with these providers and to better understand and ensure that these products operate as they are intended to.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
text: This will allow us to improve system design and put in place the probes and sensors to improve early warning.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Prime Minister)
text: We will take these lessons and apply them to the development and maintenance of other Government systems.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: In this instance, there were several factors that occurred simultaneously which resulted in a combination of an interaction between two pieces of software and an unusually high load all at the same time.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: So, this particular instance was not something that was envisioned or tested against.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: But in general, the system is tested against conditions of stress and load.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: But, again, we will review and update our procedures, going forward, having learnt from this incident.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: We were not aware that there is a particular problem at the moment.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: It may be that the delay varies over time as the load varies over time.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: So, at particularly busy periods, there may be some lag.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: This busyness cannot always be associated with the Singpass system itself.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: There may be other instances of the telecom co-providers being under load, which may also result in some lag.
